glossary.Publication Readiness: A release state where security, privacy, legal, store compliance, tests and signing gates are satisfied before Google Play/App Store submission.
glossary.Auth-first Registration: A flow where the user authenticates through Supabase Auth first, then completes profile data and consent in a controlled onboarding flow.
glossary.Onboarding Profile: The required post-auth profile step that collects full name and phone number for a new client account.
glossary.Legal Consent: An explicit user acceptance of current Privacy Policy and Terms versions before access to CRM features.
glossary.Account Deletion: A user-discoverable in-app and web-accessible process to delete an account and associated user data, with clearly disclosed retention exceptions.
glossary.Admin Chat: A private conversation between one user and authorized staff, displayed to the user as Administratsiya/Administration.
glossary.Global Announcements: A read-only channel for staff-to-user broadcasts, separated from private admin chats.
glossary.Staff Role: A server-owned role such as admin, manager or teacher. It must never be assigned or changed from user-controlled metadata or client profile updates.
glossary.Client Role: The default role for a new user account.
glossary.RLS Root Control: A Supabase Row Level Security, function, view, storage policy or Edge Function authorization rule that must enforce access regardless of Flutter UI behavior.
glossary.Release Gate: A blocking verification condition for publication, such as passing analyzer/tests, production signing, privacy disclosures and unresolved security finding count.

entities.name: UserAccount
entities.description: Supabase Auth identity for a person using the app.
security_invariants: User metadata cannot assign staff roles.

entities.name: Profile
entities.description: Application profile containing name, phone, role and app-specific metadata.
security_invariants: Clients can update only approved self-service fields.

entities.name: LegalDocument
entities.description: Privacy Policy, Terms or related compliance document with version and publication status.
security_invariants: Users accept a specific immutable version.

entities.name: ConsentRecord
entities.description: Audit record that a user accepted a legal document version.
security_invariants: Consent records are append-only for normal clients.

entities.name: DeletionRequest
entities.description: A request to delete an account and associated user data.
security_invariants: Client can request only own deletion.
Service role key is never exposed to the client.

entities.name: AdminChatThread
entities.description: Private staff-user conversation visible only to the owner user and authorized staff.
security_invariants: Client A cannot read or write Client B admin chat.

entities.name: AnnouncementChannel
entities.description: Read-only broadcast channel for staff announcements.

entities.name: MediaObject
entities.description: Avatar, chat attachment, image, file or voice message stored in Supabase Storage.
security_invariants: Private chat media is not public by default.
Object path ownership is enforced in storage policy.

entities.name: PushToken
security_invariants: Visible only to backend/staff flows that need it.
Deleted or pending-deletion users do not receive pushes.

flows.name: Admin Chat Provisioning
exit_criteria: User sees only own admin chat

flows.name: Global Announcement Publishing
exit_criteria: Clients can read but cannot reply in announcement channel

flows.name: Account Deletion
steps: Privileged backend deletes or schedules deletion
exit_criteria: Auth account and associated data are deleted unless retention exception is disclosed

missing_components: Private admin chat schema or policy
Storage signed URL and owner-path model
Release signing and store compliance checklist
Production log redaction for auth links and notification payloads

clarifications.question: Под глобальным чатом с администраторами нужен общий канал для всех новых пользователей или персональный чат каждого пользователя с администрацией?
clarifications.recommended_answer: Персональный чат Administratsiya для каждого пользователя плюс отдельный read-only канал Obyavleniya.
clarifications.answer: Confirmed by user: personal Administratsiya chat for each user plus separate read-only Obyavleniya channel.
